name: Tube Investments of India Ltd (TII)
tagline: Murugappa Group's incubator/holding engine — a debt-free precision-engineering core funding a real EV push (Montra Electric) and carrying a proven turnaround pedigree (CG Power), but already priced richly (P/E ~86) after a soft last 12 months
business_overview: TII (Chennai, Murugappa Group) manufactures precision steel tubes/strips, automotive & industrial chains, gears, and BSA/Hercules-brand bicycles, alongside financial-services and industrial investments. It engineered the widely-cited CG Power turnaround (58% stake) and holds ~70% of Shanti Gears. Its wholly-owned EV subsidiary TI Clean Mobility (Montra Electric brand) builds 3-wheelers, trucks/LCVs and EV components, alongside early-stage bets in CDMO/APIs and medical devices.
fundamentals_table: Rs 52,226 Cr (down from ~Rs 81,000 Cr in Oct-2024 per the thread — stock has de-rated)
FY26 revenue Rs 14,000 Cr; standalone PAT CAGR 24% over 5yr (Rs 735 Cr FY24)
FY26 PBIT loss Rs 412 Cr; Rs 900 Cr cash cushion (~1.5-2yr runway); targeting operational breakeven in at least 2 of its EV businesses
Rs 2,164.90 - 3,419.90; stock delivered negative returns over the last 12 months per the thread
fundamentals_narrative: The core engineering business is genuinely excellent (37.89% ROCE, net debt-free, 24% 5yr PAT CAGR) and self-funds an aggressive diversification push. A trusted user's 2024 sum-of-parts observation (market cap roughly equal to the value of TII's stakes in CG Power + Shanti Gears alone) implied the core business plus all EV/CDMO/medical-device optionality was being priced near-free — but the market cap has since fallen ~36% while the P/E remains rich at ~86x, so that specific arbitrage needs re-verification, not an unqualified carry-forward.
technical_read: Stock has delivered negative returns over the trailing 12 months per the most recent (Sep-2026) forum post, despite a still-rich P/E — a sign the market has cooled on the growth-bet story even as fundamentals (core ROCE, debt-free balance sheet) remain strong. Not independently charted this pass.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 of 77 posts (2018-2026, first-time analysis). Arc: 2018-2020 steady core-business commentary, a major 2020 pivot into industrials via the CG Power turnaround acquisition (from KKR, a fraud-hit company), 2022-2023 rapid unrelated diversification (electronics/Moshine, biofuels/X2Fuels, CDMO) drawing real community pushback on capital-allocation discipline, a 2024 family-ownership-dispute resolution, and a Sep-2026 post noting the stock's soft 1yr performance despite the CG Power halo.
community_signal: GautamBafna (trusted, elevated, Oct-2024) laid out the core sum-of-parts thesis: market cap ~ value of CG Power (58%) + Shanti Gears (70%) stakes alone, implying near-free optionality on the core engineering business, EV mobility, and early-stage medical-devices/CDMO bets — explicitly flagged holdco-discount risk tied to new-business execution. Several non-trusted but substantive posts (investor12321, rajguleria, Parth_Bhatt1, nav_1996, 2023) pushed back hard on the CDMO/APIs foray as 'de-worsification' unrelated to core competency and a capital-allocation discipline concern — a real, unresolved governance question the bulls haven't directly answered. hardik_shah1 (trusted, elevated, Oct-2024) confirmed a family-ownership dispute was cleanly settled with a SEBI-approved promoter reclassification, removing a governance overhang. karanshah137 (trusted, elevated, Aug-2025) noted a decent Q1 FY26 with Rs 1,000 Cr FY26 capex mostly into engineering/metals (not invested, tracking only). Most recent post (Paulbiplab, Sep-2026, not trusted) frames TII plainly as 'the incubator and holding engine for the Murugappa Group's most aggressive growth bets' but flags the rich P/E (~86) against negative 1yr returns.
bull_case: Genuine, demonstrated turnaround/incubation track record: the CG Power acquisition (from a fraud-hit prior owner) has been a widely-cited group value-creation success, not just a stated ambition
Core engineering business is excellent on its own terms — 37.89% ROCE, net debt-free, 24% 5yr standalone PAT CAGR — funding new bets without balance-sheet strain
Real, capital-backed EV push (TI Clean Mobility/Montra Electric raised Rs 3,000 Cr; well-funded runway of 1.5-2 years against current burn) rather than a token EV announcement
A trusted user's sum-of-parts framework (mkt cap ~ value of listed subsidiary stakes alone) offers a plausible, if now-stale, lens for underappreciated optionality
bear_case: Real, substantive community pushback on unrelated diversification (CDMO/APIs, medical devices, biofuels) as capital-allocation indiscipline/'de-worsification' rather than disciplined compounding — an open governance question, not resolved in-thread
EV segment is genuinely loss-making (Rs 412 Cr FY26 PBIT loss) with breakeven only targeted, not delivered, for at least two of its EV businesses
Stock has posted negative returns over the trailing year despite the CG Power halo, while P/E remains rich (~86x) — the market appears less convinced of the growth-bet framing lately than in 2024

Market cap has fallen ~36% since the 2024 sum-of-parts observation was made — that specific 'near-free optionality' argument needs re-verification against current CG Power/Shanti Gears valuations, not an automatic carry-forward
No live-theme keyword match on the discovery title (though the business is genuinely EV/auto-component-adjacent) — this thesis rests on the deep read, not a theme hit
verdict_headline: A genuine incubator/turnaround-engine large-cap with a real, funded EV bet — clears its own size-based default, but rich valuation and unresolved capital-discipline criticism cap conviction
verdict_reasoning: No live-theme keyword match on title/slug/excerpt (auto-ancillary and EV-ecosystem themes are priority-2 and the business clearly touches both, but the substring-match check at discovery time found no literal hit) — this is a bottom-up large-cap call built on the deep forum read, not a theme-ranked discovery hit

Large-cap inflection exception explicitly invoked: TII has a demonstrated, not merely stated, capital-allocation regime — the realized CG Power turnaround plus an actively-funded EV mobility build-out (Rs3,000cr raised) constitute a genuine structural inflection, not just 'good management'
Four-box score 3.0 (tailwind yes, moat yes, tam/valuation weak) independently clears the bar even before the large-cap exception is applied

Conviction capped at Medium: real EV losses (Rs412cr), substantive and unresolved community criticism of the unrelated CDMO/medical-devices diversification as capital-allocation indiscipline, a rich headline P/E (~86x), and a stock that has actually de-rated (~36% market-cap decline since the 2024 sum-of-parts bull case) with negative trailing-12-month returns

four_box.note: Tailwind yes: real, capital-backed EV mobility build-out (Rs3,000cr raised for TI Clean Mobility) plus a demonstrated group turnaround engine (CG Power), not just stated ambition. TAM weak: core engineering TAM is solid but mature; EV/CDMO/medical-device adjacencies add TAM optionality but are early-stage and drew real community skepticism as unfocused diversification. Moat yes: proven M&A/operational-turnaround execution capability (CG Power) plus a genuine precision-engineering competitive position, not a marketing claim. Valuation weak: P/E ~86x is rich on headline basis; a plausible-but-stale (2024) sum-of-parts argument suggests possible underappreciated optionality, but market cap has since fallen ~36% and needs re-verification, not an automatic carry-forward.

trusted_signals.signal: Market cap (~Rs81,000cr at the time) was roughly equal to the value of TII's stakes in CG Power (58%) + Shanti Gears (70%) alone — implying the core engineering business plus EV/CDMO/medical-device optionality was priced near-free; flagged that any future holdco-discount narrowing depends on new-business execution success.
Confirmed the Murugappa family ownership dispute was cleanly settled via a SEBI-approved promoter reclassification (Regulation 31A) — a governance overhang resolved, not merely papered over.
Decent-to-good Q1 FY26 numbers; FY26 capex plan of Rs1,000cr, majority allocated to the engineering & metals division (not to EV/new bets). Explicitly not invested, tracking only.
